title: EmergentTTS-Eval: Evaluating TTS Models on Complex Prosodic, Expressiveness, and Linguistic Challenges Using Model-as-a-Judge

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the category-wise standard deviation in win-rates across multiple distinct voices within the same TTS models to assess how specific speaker characteristics (e.g., pitch, timbre) affect perceived performance, particularly in expressiveness-demanding categories like Emotions and Paralinguistics.

Qualitative analysis of the LLM-as-a-judge (Gemini-2.5-Pro) to observe systematic subjective biases, such as occasionally hallucinating emotional expressions in flat outputs, demonstrating preference for literary/formal language, or favoring certain voice pitches for specific emotions.
